features.name: Personalized lyrics from a story
features.description: Fill a warm form (recipient, occasion, relationship, memories, traits, inside jokes, a closing 'message from the heart') and a local AI writes a complete, original song around it.
features.notes: Ollama via /api/lyrics/generate; structure scales to target length (verse/chorus/bridge/outro)

features.name: Real sung vocals (not instrumental)
features.description: The recipient's name is actually sung in a full performed song — verse, chorus, bridge — on the local GPU at no cost.
features.notes: ACE-Step singing model; replaced the original instrumental-only MusicGen approach

features.name: The name is always sung — correctly
features.description: If the lyric model forgets to use the name, it is auto-injected as a sung vocative; a per-language phonetic respelling fixes how it's pronounced when sung.
features.notes: ensure_name_in_lyrics + pronunciation dictionary; display lyrics keep the real name

features.name: Sing in 8 languages (+ blend)
features.description: Generate songs in English, Portuguese, Japanese, French, Spanish, Italian, German, or Korean, with native-accent conditioning — or blend two languages in one song (verses one language, chorus another).
features.notes: lang_mode = single | blend; native LANG tags prevent an English accent

features.name: Genre, mood & decade styles
features.description: Pick from pop, R&B, country, rock, jazz, hip-hop, worship, gospel and culturally specific styles (Brazilian samba/forró/bossa nova, Japanese enka & 60s/70s/80s J-pop, French chanson), with a mood/tempo control.
features.notes: _GENRE_TAGS / _MOOD_TAGS in ace_engine; genres can be blended

features.name: Choose the singer
features.description: Pick from 10 curated native-language singer presets (each a timbre + a stable seed for a consistent voice), or just male / female / instrumental.
features.notes: config/singers.json; per-language defaults; gender is verified by pitch and re-rolled if wrong

features.name: Spoken radio / concert dedication
features.description: Prepend a short spoken intro in a native voice — radio-DJ style or live-concert style (with a subtle crowd/applause bed) — so the name is pronounced perfectly even if the melody isn't.
features.notes: edge-tts neural voices; heartfelt/warm/festive tones with native wording per language

features.name: Dedication in the artist's voice
features.description: Re-voice the spoken dedication so it sounds like the singer of an uploaded song — same words, the artist's timbre.
features.notes: Demucs isolates the artist's vocal -> Seed-VC zero-shot conversion; falls back to the neural voice if unavailable

features.name: Full voice-clone cover
features.description: Generate the song, then re-sing it in a target voice extracted from any source song (YouTube link, upload, or CD), mixed over ACE-Step's or the original's instrumental.
features.notes: ACE-Step -> Demucs x2 -> Seed-VC (f0-conditioned for singing) -> mix

features.name: Pronounce-by-ear teaching
features.description: Record someone saying a tricky name; the app transcribes it and suggests a phonetic respelling you can hear previewed and edit, then reuse across songs.
features.notes: Whisper transcribe + suggest_respelling; saved per-language in pronunciations.json

features.name: Base it on an existing song
features.description: Steer a new song toward one you love with three sliders — how much to keep the melody, the lyrics, and the overall feel.
features.notes: ACE-Step audio2audio; levers map to ref_audio_strength; low lyrics-change re-uses the source's transcribed words

features.name: Bring your own audio
features.description: Import a source song to clone or remix from a YouTube/other URL, a local audio/video file (audio auto-extracted, optional trim), or by ripping an audio CD.
features.notes: yt-dlp, ffmpeg extract/transcode, libcdio CD rip; saved to a sources library

features.name: Karaoke stems
features.description: Split any finished song into vocals + instrumental and download both as a zip — instant karaoke backing track.
features.notes: Demucs two-stem; /api/library/stems/{song_id}

features.name: Local song library
features.description: Every song is saved with its lyrics, metadata, and cover, browsable and streamable in the app; delete what you don't want.
features.notes: music_library/<Occasion>/ with a .json sidecar per song

features.name: Cover art
features.description: Each song gets a tasteful auto-generated gradient cover (genre-tuned, with the name + occasion); optionally an AI-painted cover.
features.notes: PIL procedural always works; SDXL-Turbo AI cover optional in a subprocess with PIL fallback

features.name: Share bundle & QR card
features.description: Download a zip (audio + lyrics + cover), or a printable greeting card with a QR code the recipient scans to play the song from their own phone.
features.notes: QR uses the public tunnel/LAN host so it works off-device; /api/library/bundle, /api/library/card

features.name: Play on Plex / Google Home / Alexa
features.description: Finished songs are organized and tagged so they appear in Plex and can be played by voice on smart speakers.
features.notes: Sync built (ID3 tag + copy + scan); needs a Plex token + music section configured in Settings

features.name: Auto-publish to YouTube Music
features.description: Optionally upload every finished song to your personal YouTube Music library.
features.notes: ytmusicapi browser-header auth; off until you paste headers once and enable auto-upload

features.name: Album / batch mode
features.description: Generate several songs in one job (e.g. a song each for a whole family), with per-song success/failure reporting.
features.notes: /api/batch/generate; auto-writes lyrics first if not supplied

features.name: Overnight generation queue
features.description: Queue songs to generate later and run the whole queue unattended; failures stay queued for retry.
features.notes: config/queue.json; run_queue.py / POST /api/queue/run

features.name: Runs as an always-on app
features.description: Installs as a background Windows service so the studio is always available on the machine.
features.notes: QI_PersonalSong NSSM service on :8088 via serve.py

features.name: Registered QI project
features.description: Listed in the QI ecosystem registry with its port, path, family tier, and integration contracts.
features.notes: qi_registry.json; family_tier=cousin; loopback-only / not internet-exposed

features.name: Exposes song & voice generation
features.description: Advertised to the ecosystem as a provider of song generation (ACE-Step) and voice cloning (Demucs/Seed-VC).
features.notes: exposes_to_ecosystem in the registry

features.name: M2V integration (song -> music video)
features.description: Feed generated songs into the M2V project to produce music videos.
features.notes: integrates_with: m2v declared in the registry; no wiring yet
